name: box
title: Box
description: A container with token-only padding, background, radius, border and shadow.

when: Giving a group of content padding or a surface without a card's semantics.

instead.when: The content is one object with a title.

builtIn: Renders a plain element; pass `as` for semantics.
youProvide: The right element through `as` (section, nav, aside…) when it has a role.

genui.description: A padded container. Use only theme values; prefer card for an object with a title.
